Corollary
[Minimal existence time] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0239 1. Corollary 7.7\group proving-the-global-estimates

If $(\mathcal M^n,g_0)$ is a Riemannian manifold such that $|\Rm [g_0]|_{g_0}\le K$, then the unique Ricci flow solution $g(t)$ with $g(0)=g_0$ exists at least for $t\in [0,c/K]$, where $c>0$ depends only on $n$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0239 \sketch Apply Corollary 1. Corollary 7.5 to the maximal solution starting at $g_0$. The curvature bound can double only after time $c/K$, so the solution cannot break down before that time.

□
